bio.text: Charles Tuttle is an independent candidate for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026.

He has run for office before: for U.S. House in 2018, for North Dakota Superintendent of Public Instruction in 2020, and for North Dakota Secretary of State in 2022, and he also ran in the June 2026 special primary for Superintendent of Public Instruction.

sources.title: North Dakota US House challengers advocate for change
